strings.en: You've got nowhere left to run!
Don't count on a second stroke!
Leave the close combat to me!
I'm taking the first move! Here goes!
I'll show you the Choukijin's power!
Crystal Dragoon.../　I'll show you the power of the Choukijin!
XN-L, I won't let you go any farther!
And no turning back either! We'll defeat you here!
If it uses a spear too!
I'll show you the Grungust's strength!
I'll show you Boxer's explosive speed!
I'll beat that attitude out of you!
I'm not backing down an inch, Jua-Mu.
Don't think obsession alone can beat us!
Jua-Mu, I'll show you an Earthling's grit!
Let's settle this head-on, Al-Van Ranks!
Even against a Raftclans, there's a way!
I'll cut you down before you cut me!!
A duel with a knight... I accept!
Don't think you can stop us, Fu-Ruu!
Just because she's a woman.../　If I hold back, I'll be the one going down!
Gu-Landon, you have no just cause!
I'll end your war right here!
That power steeped in ambition... we'll shatter it!
That Raig-Geios... its range is hard to read.
I can't let myself/　get caught up in their pace...!
I'm used to opponents of that type...!
I'll carve a path to the Rabulpaila...!
I won't let you swing that great scythe!
The only thing getting stained red is your unit!
I'll defeat that man/　and end the war with Gadisword!
Herluga, I won't hand the Cross Gate to you!
Something like that is a Dark Brain remnant...?!
It doesn't care which unit it controls...!
If it's unmanned, I won't hold back!
That unit's under the Madnet too...!
No matter how many puppets you gather!
Possessing a Yokijin was your mistake!
That one's a Dark Brain remnant too...?!
Even if it really has the power/　to destroy intelligent life...!
I absolutely can't lose this battle!
XN-L! You'll never fulfill your mission!
I'll drive you back as many times as it takes!
No matter how many times/　you come to the Earth Sphere!
The war with the Zovorg should be over...!
I won't play along with your business!
I won't let the Golaikunru do as they please!
I won't let you through here!
If I take out the Commander's unit...!
I'll take on that commander unit!
I won't be outmuscled by a Zeidram!
I'll aim for the lightly armored blocks!
I'll whittle down the Fury's forces, even a little!
A Big Shoulder. I'll take it down!
Once I'm inside its guard, even Thorn...!
All I can do now is fall back...!
I'll clear out the Lamaris in one go!
Even if they combine, I'll do the same thing!
I have to beat the Kaana type fast!
That form... Don't tell me it means it's still growing!
I can't let that giant Lamaris/　get out of here!
With that bulk, I'm the faster one!
It's even more sinister than in the data...!
Listen to Arieil's voice, Duban Org!
Once I hold it down, it's up to you, Arieil!
I won't just sit on the defensive!
The best defense is a good offense!
An opening comes right after an attack!
I've been waiting for this moment!
I was... already prepared for this!!
Waaagh!/　Wh-what is this thing's power!?
Gah! I won't let it end here!!
Damn! Don't think I'll back/　down over something like this!!
Ugh! Th-this pain.../　I won't forget it!!
Regrets can wait. First, I get out of this!
Damn, it's because I'm too green...!!
Ngh! If it's come to this...!!
It's too early to fall, KoRyuOh!
The tiger's fangs... aren't broken yet!
No way!/　It got through this armor so easily...!?
Gah!!/　Ngh... The heavy armor saved me...!
Not good! The frame's taking damage!!
Ngh! I never had much hope/　for its defense to begin with...!
Ugh! I have to stop Herluga fast!
No time to waste on the Lamaris Kaana!
Ngh! I still need more training...!
Take a cut to break the bone!!
Got me, huh!?/　But don't think that'll work/　a second time!
I'll turn this situation into a chance!
If I can take this hit, I can still win!
Bullet, don't push yourself so hard!
I'm fine, don't worry about it!
Damn, they got in this close!
Bullet,/　you should pull back for now!
This much is nothing, I'm still okay!
That was a direct hit, Bullet!
Ngh, it kept up with KoRyuOh...!
As if KoRyuOh/　would flinch at that...!
KoRyuOh!/　We can't afford to lose!
This machine can still take it!
Ugh! I don't want to rely on armor to fight, but...
Th-this thing's tougher than it looks...
Tch! I couldn't make full use of my mobility...!
Another hit.../　would be fatal in this thing...!
Don't think this is all/　a Gespenst can do!
If this weren't the Type-3,/　that might've been fatal...!
Don't think that's enough for a knockdown!
I can't lose to a Fury knight!
The Knight Commander title isn't just for show...!
I've no intention of shedding blood!
I have to pull him away from the Cross Gate...!
Damn Crystal Dragoon, it's aiming precisely...!
Skull Knight! That's not enough to bring me down!
If we don't hold off the XN-L here...!
So they have data on us too...!
Like I'd let the Fury beat me!
Ugh, I can't shake off Thorn!!
Like I'd ever join the ghosts!
The Lamaris are getting more active...!
If I struggle with that Kaana type...!
I have to defeat the giant Lamaris no matter what...!
That power.../　It's on par with Einst Regisseur...!
Something like this won't scare me off!!
My reads are still too sloppy...!
I can't fight if I'm afraid of failing!
How pathetic, I couldn't dodge it...!
I'll make up for this mistake right away!
Uh, huh?/　Guess I didn't look too cool there...
This doesn't even count as a scratch!
So you've caught up to KoRyuOh!
I knew they'd target this machine!!
Phew... The machine saved me there.
This thing can handle a little abuse...!
Ngh!/　I have to use this unit's traits better!
You think that'll bring down a Gespenst!?
A Grungust can take this much!
Like a graze would stop Boxer!
Is that all a knight's got?!
Even an Emperor unit's attack, I'll take it!
Gomoudokka.../　Doesn't seem he's just relying on his unit's specs.
Vort! That won't make me flinch!
Is that all Gadisword's elite have?!
If they keep using the Cross Gate like this...!
Sorcery or not, if this is all it is!
Your illusions won't work on me!
This guy's full of surprise attacks...!
Crystal Dragoon.../　So it was waiting for its chance.
No need to hold back, Skull Knight!
You won't take my life, XN-L!
Ugh, I know its data, and yet!
Thorn... Is it feeling me out...?
I couldn't shake off the Lamaris Kaana...!
The giant Lamaris's power is growing...!
I can't let the Ida type activate!
Those wings give it more burst speed?!
If I can read the movement!!
What do you plan to do with a strike like that?!
Relax. It can't keep up with KoRyuOh.
That attack was easy to read!
But don't let your guard down!
Another one might be coming, be careful!
We may be slow,/　but if I can read their attacks...!
Even a Grungust can manage this much!
I'll hold my own against Fury knights too!
Karo-Ran, if you're coming, come for real!
I won't let you become emperor!
Don't think you can do as you please, Gomoudokka!
Even with the Cross Gate, it has to hit me first!
Is that all your sorcery can do?!
I know your range, Skull Knight!
XN-L, you have no right to destroy humanity!
I've got data on Zovorg units!
That Raig-Geios.../　It isn't showing the power in the data.
Good, now I can draw them in even more.
Like I'd let that thing possess me!
Getting bigger made your aim sloppy!
It's faster, sure... but that's all.
I won't fall behind against Yokijin!
Oh, ha ha ha... It's all thanks to KoRyuOh.
All right...! Let's shake him off like this!
Looks like they're coming at us again!/　Be careful!
All right, let's keep this up!
That's what you get for/　not checking your target!
Ngh...! Did I misjudge the distance?!
I won't let that opening slip by!
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
Lieutenant Kyosuke, I'll back you up!
Impressive...!/　With timing like this, I can do it!
Maybe I'm just getting in the way, but.../　You're not getting away!
Lieutenant Excellen! Leave the rest to me!
Major Sänger, I'll back you up!
Major Sänger, let's do a Cooperative Attack!
Tasuku, you're too sloppy on the finish!
Sorry, Tasuku... the finishing blow is mine!
Ryoto, I'll lend you a hand!
Major, I'll take it from here!
Yuuki! Leave the rest to me!
Don't let your guard down till it's over! Carla!
Lamia, go for the next target!
Lamia, I'll take care of the rest!
Ryusei, leave the rest to me!
Rätsel, please leave the rest to me!
Captain Viletta, I'll back you up!
Lieutenant Hugo, I'll back you up!
Lieutenant Aqua, I'll take it from here!
Leave the rest to me, Josh!
Josh, I'm backing you up/　whether you like it or not!
Rim, leave the rest to me!
Touya, leave the rest to me!
Akemi, I'll take it from here!
KoRyuOh! With your speed, we can do it!
Lieutenant Excellen! Get behind me, quick!
Ryoto! Leave that one to me!
Lamia, get out while you can!
Ryusei, you're charging in too far!
Captain Viletta, leave this to me!
Josh, I'll take care of that one!
Josh,/　I'm shielding you, like it or not!
You need to fall back, Touya!
I won't let this chance slip!
KoRyuOh's ultimate technique!/　Tiger King Rampage!!
I'll cut you down with this!
It's reckless, but I have no choice/　but to use this!!
Behold it with your own eyes!/　Gigante Unghia!!
I have to read the enemy's movements...!
Take this! The blade of the Shishioh!
It may not be a sword, but I'll make it work...!
Now you know the edge of the Rahu Blade!
Your path leads only to ruin...!
This is the Type-1 Kai's secret technique!
The Type-3 has tactics like this too!
With singular purpose... one clean cut...!
Now you know the edge of the Shishioh Blade!
This is the Type-3 Kai's new secret technique!
Let's settle this with these fists!
I'll master even a sword of gravity!
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
Soar through the heavens while you're at it!
An evil star in the heavens, a spirit star on earth!
Can you read these twin swords?!
